data.narrative:
Argotec is a Growth-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by David Avino, currently targeting €75M in capital. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Traditional triangulation methods encounter material constraints. Peer-median analysis is inapplicable: while 11 same-sector peers exist, filtering by stage and valuation tier yields fewer than 3 datapoints, rendering narrow-set medians unreliable. Public-comp anchoring using the 6-ticker Space & Aerospace median P/S multiple of 23.9x cannot be executed without disclosed target revenue, which private companies rarely publish. The sector's heterogeneity—spanning launch, on-orbit services, and satellite operations—further limits meaningful peer segmentation at this stage.

No triangulated valuation range can be supported by the available data. Establishing a defensible range requires either: (1) Argotec's revenue or comparable financial metrics disclosed by the company, enabling public multiple application; (2) a sufficient cluster of same-stage, comparable-revenue private transactions; or (3) management-provided forward guidance permitting DCF calibration. The €75M raise target itself provides only a capital requirement signal, not a valuation anchor. Further diligence should prioritize obtaining Argotec's financials and clarifying its specific subsector positioning within Space & Aerospace.
